hypothesis: Assigning each 16x16 output tile in one of the nine 32x32 output blocks to a separate CTA may reduce per-CTA live state and increase exposed parallelism enough to offset duplicated circuit work.

single_proposed_mapping.output_block_owner: program_id(2) selects one of nine 32x32 output blocks; program_id(0/1) selects its 16x16 tile
single_proposed_mapping.semantics: Take the exact transitive dependency slice of the original 55-gate straight-line program for each original output store. Do not rewrite arithmetic or change evaluation order inside a branch. Recompute shared gates and products across CTAs as required by independent output ownership.
single_proposed_mapping.constraints: One kernel launch, no atomics, no explicit product scratch, FP16 input/output, FP32 input combinations and output reconstruction, tf32x3 products, four warps, two stages.
single_proposed_mapping.tradeoff: The 2.78x extra source-level dot work and 3.20x source-level addition instances may dominate any gain from 9x more CTAs and lower per-CTA live state. The live-value model is not a register or occupancy measurement.

evaluation_limit: Compile and test this one mapping. Permit at most one minimal adjustment only if compilation or correctness requires it. Stop before paired timing if numerical or physical topology gates fail.
